 Kaun Banega Crorepati 18: Ravie Dubey opens up about landing the role of Lakshman in ‘Ramayana’, says he and Sargun Mehta believe in ‘kripa’ 
 Kaun Banega Crorepati 18: Ravie Dubey opens up about landing the role of Lakshman in ‘Ramayana’, says he and Sargun Mehta believe in ‘kripa’ 
 etimes.in / Oct 27, 2026, 15:35 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Kaun Banega Crorepati season 18's Diwali special episode is going to be grand and special as the cast of Ramayana is all set to grace the show. Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey will be seen taking on the hot seat of KBC 18. The official Instagram page of the channel recently dropped a promo from the episode where actor Ravie Dubey opened up on playing the supreme character of Lord Lakshman in the upcoming cinematic epic Ramayana. He stated that it still feels surreal. Admitting that even after completing the shoot nearly two-and-a-half years ago, the magnitude of the opportunity has yet to sink in. The actor opened up about his emotional journey on a Diwali special episode of popular quiz reality show, Kaun Banega Crorepati, hosted by megastar Amitabh Bachchan . During the conversation, Amitabh Bachchan asked Ravie Dubey what was going through his mind, prompting the actor to reflect on his experience of being part of the epic. He asked, “Ravi ji aap se poochenge... aap ke man mein kya chal raha tha..” (Ravi ji, I would like to ask you... what was going through your mind?) Speaking about the surreal experience of being part of the mythological saga, Ravi Dubey shared his candid and deeply emotional thoughts, “Sir, mujhe to abhi bhi, do-dhai saal ho gaye picture shoot karte hue aur aaj aapke samaksh hum sabhi baithe hue hain. Mujhe toh abhi bhi aisa lag raha hai ki yeh ho nahi raha hai, shayad mere dimaag mein hi kahin yeh chhalava sa ek sapna sa kuch chal raha hai..” (Sir, it has been two-and-a-half years since we shot the film, and today, we are all sitting here in front of you. I still find it hard to believe that this is actually happening. It feels like a dream, as if my mind is playing tricks on me.) Ravie went on to talk about the moment when he bagged the prestigious role of Lakshman and expressed his gratitude, he added, “5 November ko picture aane wali hai... to jab pehli dafa sir pata chala ki main... Ramayan mein Lakshman ka paatra nibha raha hoon, to... main stabdh sa reh gaya jo kehte hain na ki sink-in nahi hua hai, main sach bol raha hoon hand-to-heart, that... abhi bhi mujhe lagta hai ki sink-in nahi hua hai. .. lekin main aur meri patni Sargun hum yeh maante hain ki cheezein agar... hoti hain to keval kripa se hoti hain, divine ordinance se aur divine grace se hi hoti hain..” (The film is set to release on November 5. When I first found out that I would be playing Lakshman in Ramayan, I was stunned. As they say, it just didn’t sink in. Honestly, hand on heart, I still feel like it hasn’t fully sunk in. My wife, Sargun, and I believe that whatever happens in life is only because of divine blessings, divine will and divine grace.) For the uninitiated, Ramayan stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Maa Sita.
